warnings: Pile caps on I-section piles I 0.18 x 0.18 m with dowel bars (F1 one pile, F2 two piles), SAFE LOAD 13 t/pile; pile length not printed.

main_bar.count is the two-way total (section 6b). F1 is square 0.36 x 0.36 (printed on its left side and top), so depth_mm is omitted. F2's other plan side (0.18 + 0.18 = 0.36) and its 1.00 / 0.50 / 0.05 depth chain are printed on its left side, between the two details.

Depths below ระดับดินเดิม (1.00 to the cap top, cap 0.50, lean concrete 0.05, sand 0.05) are printed against a level that carries no value, so they stay on the elements, not in the grid master's z_levels.
Both views are kept in one file (one element each, no id collision), like the S-04 footing files of houses 93/95.
